title: The Geometry of Real Anisotropic Bohnenblust--Hille Constants
summary: We determine the growth scale of the optimal constants in the real anisotropic Bohnenblust--Hille inequality. For an exponent vector $\mathbf q^{(m)}$, write $C_{\mathbf q^{(m)}}^{(m)}$ for its optimal constant and $d_m$ for its diameter. These constants are superpolynomial precisely when $m d_m/\log m\to\infty$; throughout this regime, their logarithm has the sharp scale $m d_m$. If also $d_m\to0$, then $\log C_{\mathbf q^{(m)}}^{(m)}/(m d_m)$ lies asymptotically in the interval $\left[\frac{\log 2}{4},\frac{2-\log 2-γ}{4}\right]$, where $γ$ is the Euler--Mascheroni constant; this interval…
